title: Thai Chocolate Empanadas
description: A unique fusion dessert combining the flavors of Thailand and South America. Crunchy empanadas filled with a rich, malty, and chocolatey filling.
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the chocolate, sugar, peanut oil, and vanilla extract.
Add the chili powder and mix well.
Place a small spoonful of the chocolate mixture onto one half of each empanada.
Fold the other half of the empanada over to form a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of peanut oil.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Optional: Garnish with a sprinkle of powdered sugar or a few chopped peanuts.
